Text.Text: The halls can teach safely again. Keep your footing, and help your next student find theirs. You've finished my Saber Cyclone trials. I have no further work for you here.
The cyclone trials require rank 50 in Saberstaff. Reach that rank, then come back. One motion needs two steady hands.

Students in the trial halls are practicing the cyclone without control. Recover their trial slate so I can see where the instruction failed. Defeat six Saber Cyclone Adepts in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Their defeat secures the Saber Cyclone Enclave Trial Slate; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Interior. I'll give you the Dantooine Jedi Enclave Trial Halls Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Saber Cyclone.

Here's the Dantooine Jedi Enclave Trial Halls Key. Use 'Jedi Enclave Trial Halls' in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Library. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Saber Cyclone Adepts, then return with the Saber Cyclone Enclave Trial Slate.

Most forms plant their feet and swing. The cyclone never plants. The staff keeps turning -- every parry feeds the next arc, defense becomes orbit, and whatever steps into the orbit gets carried out of it. What they're doing down there is all spin and no center. You'll learn the difference by unmaking theirs.

Use 'Jedi Enclave Trial Halls' in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Library. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Saber Cyclone Adepts in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Their defeat secures the Saber Cyclone Enclave Trial Slate; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Interior.

Adepts who've drilled the cyclone's opening turns until they're reflex. Reflex without judgment cuts in both directions -- they won't stop at first blood, because nobody taught them where a drill ends. Don't extend your arcs to impress them. Six, cleanly, and out.
Defeat six Saber Cyclone Adepts in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Their defeat secures the Saber Cyclone Enclave Trial Slate; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Interior.
You've defeated six Saber Cyclone Adepts. Let me see the Saber Cyclone Enclave Trial Slate.
The training record is back. We can see what went wrong. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists have taken the enclave's focus shard for their drills. Bring it back. Defeat five Saber Cyclone Specialists in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Their defeat secures the Saber Cyclone Kyber Focus Shard; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Interior.
Your key still grants access to Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Defeat five Saber Cyclone Specialists to secure the Saber Cyclone Kyber Focus Shard, then return to me.

Kyber holds a note when you feed it attention. The specialists use the shard as a false center -- focus on the stone and the cyclone feels effortless, right up until the stone isn't there. It's a crutch dressed as a doctrine. That's why it comes out of the halls and into my hand.

Use 'Jedi Enclave Trial Halls' in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Library. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat five Saber Cyclone Specialists in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Their defeat secures the Saber Cyclone Kyber Focus Shard; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Interior.

Better than the adepts, and worse. The shard smooths their gaps, so they're flawless until you break their tempo -- then they stumble over their own orbit. Change your speed and keep changing it. And they spar live steel down there, so treat every exchange as real. It is.
Defeat five Saber Cyclone Specialists in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Their defeat secures the Saber Cyclone Kyber Focus Shard; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Interior.
You've defeated five Saber Cyclone Specialists. Let me see the Saber Cyclone Kyber Focus Shard.
That equipment no longer serves their drills. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden holds the trial ring for the students. Recover his fractured sigil and end his watch. Defeat the Saber Cyclone Warden in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Their defeat secures the Saber Cyclone Fractured Trial Sigil; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Interior. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Saber Cyclone Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Saber Cyclone Fractured Trial Sigil.

He graded my students for twenty years. He graded me, once -- passed me, which I've held against him ever since. Somewhere in the scoring he stopped seeing duelists and started seeing gaps. Whatever he says to you mid-fight, don't answer. He's counting the syllables you waste.
In Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Saber Cyclone Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker.

A cyclone with twenty years of patience at its center. He doesn't tire, he doesn't chase, and every solo challenge the students sent him ended the same way. Alone, you're a lesson he's already graded. Three of you are a problem he hasn't -- so bring the problem.

Defeat the Saber Cyclone Warden in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Their defeat secures the Saber Cyclone Fractured Trial Sigil; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Interior. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Saber Cyclone Warden. Let me see the Saber Cyclone Fractured Trial Sigil.
The warden's watch is over. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

Four senior students still control the school's trials. Take back their council chit. Defeat four members of the Saber Cyclone Inner Circle in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Their defeat secures the Saber Cyclone Council Trial Chit; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Interior.
Your key still grants access to Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Defeat four members of the Saber Cyclone Inner Circle to secure the Saber Cyclone Council Trial Chit, then return to me.

The warden's chosen -- the four he scored highest. Each one built their cyclone around a different lie: speed, reach, endurance, fury. Together they cover one another's gaps, which is the only true thing he ever taught them.

Use 'Jedi Enclave Trial Halls' in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Library. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat four members of the Saber Cyclone Inner Circle in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Their defeat secures the Saber Cyclone Council Trial Chit; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Interior.

Four cyclones that learned to orbit each other. Split them if you can. If you can't, bring enough blades that splitting stops mattering. And watch the one who hangs back -- the warden always graded patience highest.

Defeat four members of the Saber Cyclone Inner Circle in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Their defeat secures the Saber Cyclone Council Trial Chit; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Interior.
You've defeated four members of the Saber Cyclone Inner Circle. Let me see the Saber Cyclone Council Trial Chit.
Their instructors no longer hold the authority to teach. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

The master is the last teacher holding the halls. Defeat her in the Saber Trial Chamber to finish the cyclone trials. Defeat the Saber Cyclone Master in Dantooine, Saber Trial Chamber. Report back to me here in Dantooine, Interior; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Dantooine, Saber Trial Chamber, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Saber Cyclone Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

She was the best center I ever saw. Still, kind, certain -- then the turning became the center, and the rest of her went into it. What's down there remembers every form and none of the reasons. If she speaks, it will sound like me on my best day. It isn't me. It's the form, talking to itself.
In Dantooine, Saber Trial Chamber, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Saber Cyclone Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker.

The cyclone as I'll never teach it. Both blades always in motion, nothing wasted, nothing spared -- the very turn you're trying to earn, sharpened by years alone in the dark. A cyclone alone just digs its own crater. Hers is deep. Don't step into it with fewer than three.

Defeat the Saber Cyclone Master in Dantooine, Saber Trial Chamber. Report back to me here in Dantooine, Interior; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Saber Cyclone Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
The halls can teach safely again. Keep your footing, and help your next student find theirs. You've earned the right to train Saber Cyclone. Your final payment is ready.
Keep walking. Tell me the trial again.
I'll defeat six Saber Cyclone Adepts.
What is the cyclone, exactly?
Where do I find these adepts?
What am I walking into?
Not yet. My footing isn't there.
Here's the Saber Cyclone Enclave Trial Slate.
Slow down -- the specialists. Go over it again.
I'll defeat five Saber Cyclone Specialists.
What does the shard actually do?
Where do the specialists train?
How do they fight?
Not this turn. Give me a day.
Here's the Saber Cyclone Kyber Focus Shard.
Say the assignment again. All of it.
I'll defeat the Saber Cyclone Warden.
Who is this warden?
Where is the trial ring?
What will he throw at us?
My blades aren't here yet. Soon.
Here's the Saber Cyclone Fractured Trial Sigil.
Back to the four. I'm listening.
I'll defeat four members of the Saber Cyclone Inner Circle.
Who are the inner circle?
Where are they holed up?
How do the four fight together?
When my edge comes back. Not before.
Here's the Saber Cyclone Council Trial Chit.
Start over. I want to hear all of it again.
I'll face the Saber Cyclone Master and report back.
What did she become?
Where does she wait?
What should we expect from her?
Not until my people are ready. She can wait.
The Saber Cyclone Master is defeated. Here's my report.
